title: Maximize Your Firm’s Visibility With Accountant Google Ads - Marketing Tips For Accounting Firms | CPA Site Solutions Blog

facts.fact: The CPA Site Solutions article 'Maximize Your Firm's Visibility With Accountant Google Ads' was published on 2024-07-09.
The article suggests accountants can use radius targeting around their office or target specific zip codes to focus Google Ads on local clients.
facts.quote: Use radius targeting to reach customers within a certain distance of your office, or target specific zip codes where your ideal clients reside.

facts.fact: The article cites 'certified public accountant near me' and 'tax preparation services' as example keyword phrases for accountant Google Ads campaigns.
facts.quote: Consider phrases like “certified public accountant near me” or “tax preparation services” to attract qualified leads.

facts.fact: The article states that smart bidding strategies in an AdWords MCC account can automatically adjust bids based on the likelihood of conversion.
facts.quote: You can enable smart bidding strategies in your AdWords MCC account to automatically adjust bids based on the likelihood of conversion.
